author: ayy
body:
Title says it all, opinions?

Personally, in the last week, I've been punished for helping staff trial the junior moderators, for reporting a rule breaker, for asking why I was punished, and for arguing against homophobia. I'm just a little confused as to what I've been punished for, so how about you guys stop ignoring the emails I have sent you.

Before someone locks this, it is a suggestion, I am not focussing on any specific punishments.

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
The Sr Moderators are in charge of the support email. Do not expect to get a reply right after you send an appeal, since the Sr Moderators have lives as well.
If you do not receive a response within 1 week of sending your appeal, please resend, since some of the emails tend to get lost due to the large amount of appeals.
I do not know how many emails the Sr Moderators get on average, but please try to understand that they are doing their best to get back to go ASAP.

Feel free to ask any more questions if you still need clarification! :D

replies.body:
Locking, seeing as the discussion has derailed from its original intent, which has been thoroughly answered. You should receive a reply within 48 hours, as stated on the support page. Handling 10-20 emails per day means there will be instances where we cannot reply in said time frame and you'll just have to wait your turn. That's not the case for your email yet, as it has been even less than 24 hours.

Note that our appeal system is getting an upgrade come the next update to be more efficient and accurate.
